event.tilda_heart2.0.text: Just the account I wanted! Come here, [player]. This one won't fit in a bag.
event.tilda_heart2.0.why: four of my scene lines opened with 'Oh'; keeps the strongest (story_notes) and varies this one

event.tilda_heart8.intro.text: Yearly stocktake. Shift the flour for me? There's a tin back there I've been carefully not looking at.
event.tilda_heart8.intro.why: broke the '<day> stocktake, and...' shape it shared with tilda_friend's ask

event.overheard_tilda_felix_1.l1.text: Felix. Your carp is eight coins today. Yesterday it was six.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_1.l1.why: 'On Monday' can be false on a Monday; 'yesterday' also sets up Felix's 'overnight' joke harder

event.overheard_tilda_wren_3.l1.text: Six days straight at that counter. Save me a seat later?
event.overheard_tilda_wren_3.l1.why: 'this week' could be false early in a week; scene plays any day

event.overheard_tilda_felix_3.l2.text: A very good fish, Felix. It stays up until the thaw.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_3.l2.why: thins the 'Oh' opener tic; echoing 'fish' back is more her

dlg.tilda.birthday.r0.text: Top of the slate, that one. I'll see it first thing every morning.
dlg.tilda.birthday.r0.why: third 'Oh' opener removed; expr happy carries the fluster

threads.tilda_heart2: One recipe exists in her mother's hand, somewhere behind flour she has never moved.
threads.tilda_heart4: The player's chalk column is open now, and being on the slate means coming back.
threads.tilda_heart5: A standing Thursday chair, and the polite lie about baking fewer scones.
threads.tilda_heart6: Whether the street stays short, and keeping the worry from Felix.
threads.tilda_heart8: Whether the pie baked from the card will taste like her mother's.
threads.tilda_heart10: The farm's name in paint under hers; what the supplier grows next.
threads.tilda_friend: A new slate entry, 'saved the display,' waiting to be repaid.
threads.tilda_birthday: Whatever the player glimpsed on the slate stays unread aloud.
threads.story_notes_tilda: Two more doors get notes before closing, and Wren must not find out.
threads.story_scarecrows: Rematch next fall, and a runner-up standing thoughtful in somebody's field.
threads.overheard_tilda_felix_2: 'Thin Ice' is still chalked in capitals, and Felix will walk past it again.
threads.overheard_tilda_felix_3: Tea for two 'again': the customer who finally sits down is Felix.
threads.overheard_tilda_felix_4: The crust-and-fish treaty holds; Ledger eats better than either of them.
threads.overheard_tilda_juno_1: A smiley face too priceless to charge for, stamped on her books.
threads.overheard_tilda_juno_3: Juno's forge next door, and a street with more noise coming.

notes: Piper: confirmed from my side — the lamp stays (shipped daily line untouched), so the hall_dance chorus 'wherever the lamp is on' is safe.
Felix: 'test it' opener confirmed; my 'you fell in' reply in overheard_tilda_felix_2 is unchanged and lands.
Ledger is the cat's name in all my scene lines (heart4 intro, heart6 r2, birthday r2, felix_4 toast); Wren's story_cat 'owes her rent' agrees.

tilda_heart10 still gives only pumpkin pie and plays sfx coin; my lines promise nothing undelivered, but the bible's two-note bell handover is unpaid. When mechanics reopen: sfx coin to bell, and consider a bell beat.

hall_dance closing narration (Marcus's) reads 'Tilda takes hers beside him' with both of us on separate background dance anims; wording says 'beside', not together, but the Director should confirm it passes the no-two-dancing staging rule.
